spec_match.rationale: Applies the exact Chrome 154 grammar values (none | [ [before|after] || [links|tabs] ]) fetched from css-overflow-5 and reports per-declaration CSS.supports, inline acceptance, and computed value.

interactive.rationale: Seven value buttons re-declare the property on a real working carousel; the readout table, status region, and marker row all change per interaction.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises live per-keyword probe results on one carousel and that is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the mode-only value the build browser rejects, the none value that removes the group, and the honest fallback path when a declaration is dropped; the deep matrix lives in grammar-edge-cases.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5109685301673984 and the css-overflow-5 propdef section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes each exact declaration separately (including spec-valid values this build rejects, which fail honestly) plus a computed-value round-trip and an invalid-value rejection script; role/keyboard semantics are a manual assertion because page JS cannot observe them.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven run on Chromium 141: clicked after tabs/tabs/none/after buttons, verified supports true/false/true/true readouts, computed values (after tabs, none, after links), carousel scrollLeft 0->real offset, zero console errors, desktop+mobile(360, DPR3) screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts mode-value-applied on success and mode-value-rejected-fallback on the rejection branch, plus modes-banner-honest at load; intentional console.log lines only.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, pressed buttons flip background and color together, verdict colours (emerald/rose) sit on near-white surfaces.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with aria-pressed state, visible :focus-visible outlines, readouts in a dl plus an aria-live output, markers get :focus-visible styling; marker-group semantics themselves are the feature under test and are described honestly.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP device emulation at 360x740-1600 DPR3 shows documentElement.scrollWidth 360 (no page overflow; wide slide boxes live inside the scroll container by design); buttons are 44px min-height and the readout collapses to one column under 480px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible tabs keyboard interaction roving tabindex
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements, manage toggle state with ARIA state attributes, and always style :focus-visible explicitly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Value switcher uses native <button> with aria-pressed, 3px accent-blue :focus-visible outlines on buttons and on the ::scroll-marker pseudo-elements.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap: wrap whenever overflow is possible and gap instead of child margins; prefix positional alignment with safe.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The button row wraps with gap spacing; the marker group uses justify-content: safe center with overflow-x auto because the UA sheet's contain:size prevents auto-sizing.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Highlight the currently snapped item via CSS state rather than scripted bookkeeping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Active marker styling is pure :target-current (background/color inversion); no script tracks the active slide.

openQuestions.title: Re-measure the readouts on a real Chrome 154 build
openQuestions.detail: On the Chromium 141 used to build this page, 'after tabs' parses but 'tabs' alone does not, and the banner says so. Once a Chrome 154 binary is available to the verification environment, re-run the page there and confirm the banner switches to the full-grammar message and 'tabs (mode only)' flips to supported, then refresh the recorded evidence.

summary: Canonical grammar demo: one real carousel, every scroll-marker-group value applied for real, three independent oracles reported per declaration, and honest fallback when the build browser rejects a spec-valid value. Verified by CDP interaction run on Chromium 141 with zero console errors.
